title: Crispy Minty Keto Beef Stir Fry
description: A keto beef stir fry with a crunchy and refreshing twist, featuring crispy minty beef and crunchy vegetables.
instructions: 1. Slice the beef into thin strips and season with salt and peppercorn.
2. Heat the olive oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add the beef to the wok and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
4. Add the crunchy (bell peppers, carrots) to the wok and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
5. Add the fresh mint leaves to the wok and cook for 1 minute.
6. Add the keto stir-fry sauce to the wok and stir well to combine.
7. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
8. Serve the crispy minty beef stir fry hot and enjoy!
9. Garnish with additional fresh mint leaves if desired.
